name: deepseek-subagent
description: Route selected DeepSeek models through native Codex child tasks with live output.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate work to a native DeepSeek child task.
interface.longDescription: Uses a user-scoped macOS, Windows, or Linux loopback router so native spawn_agent child tasks can run the selected DeepSeek Responses model with live Codex output while parent requests continue to the upstream resolved from their active ChatGPT-authenticated provider. Configure the API key and model in Settings → Integrations, then start a new task.
defaultPrompt: Open DeepSeek Subagent settings to configure the API key and default model.
Use a native DeepSeek child task to inspect this project and return a concise evidence-backed report.
Delegate this bounded implementation to a native DeepSeek child task, then review its diff and tests.
